description: Tests (1) symptom resolution tracking: migraine reported then explicitly resolved, resolution must appear alongside original symptom in recall; (2) care timeline precision: doctor visit, lab results with exact numbers (HbA1c 7.1%, cholesterol 224, LDL 148), follow-up appointment with date; (3) flu vaccine capture; (4) casual weight mention captured. Failure modes: resolution event not linked to original symptom keyword; exact lab numbers lost to paraphrase; care dates dropped.
